description_en: Scales in the instances of an application
name: ScaleInApplication

parameters.description_en: The ID of the application. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID. For more information, see [ListApplication](~~149390~~).
parameters.description_zh: 应用ID，您可通过查询[ListApplication](~~149390~~)接口获取。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，您可通过查询https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html接口获取
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the elastic compute container (ECC) that corresponds to the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance to be removed for the application. Separate multiple ECC IDs with commas (,). You can call the QueryApplicationStatus operation to query the ECC ID. For more information, see [QueryApplicationStatus](~~149394~~).
parameters.description_zh: 应用下需要缩容的机器的eccid，多个用“,”分开，您可以通过调用[QueryApplicationStatus](~~149394~~)接口获取eccid。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the elastic compute container (ECC) that corresponds to the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance to be removed for the application. parameters.name: ecc_info

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to forcibly unpublish the application from the ECS instance. You need to set this parameter to true only if the ECS instance expires. In normal cases, you do not need to set this parameter to true.
parameters.description_zh: 是否要强制下线，一般只有ECS过期了才会设为true，正常情况不用填写。
